import pandas as pd

# List of source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_1/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_1/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_1/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_1/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_1/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_1/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_1/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_1/training_7.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_1/training_8.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_1/training_9.csv",
]

# Columns to keep and their target types
target_columns = {
    'company_permalink': str,
    'funded_year': int,
    'raised_amount_usd': int,
}

dfs = []

for file_path in source_files:
    # Read CSV with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)

    # Select only the target columns
    df_selected = df[['company_permalink', 'funded_year', 'raised_amount_usd']].copy()

    # Convert company_permalink to string (should already be string, but enforce)
    df_selected['company_permalink'] = df_selected['company_permalink'].astype(str)

    # Convert funded_year to integer:
    # Some source tables have float (e.g., 2003.0), convert safely by rounding or casting
    # We will convert to numeric first, then to int, coercing errors to NaN and dropping them
    df_selected['funded_year'] = pd.to_numeric(df_selected['funded_year'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

    # Convert raised_amount_usd to integer:
    # Some values are float, convert by rounding and casting
    df_selected['raised_amount_usd'] = pd.to_numeric(df_selected['raised_amount_usd'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

    dfs.append(df_selected)

# UNION operation: concatenate all dataframes vertically
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Optional: If needed, reset index (already done by ignore_index=True)

# Write the result to the target path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_1/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_1/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_1/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_1/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_1/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_1/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_1/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_1/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_1/training_7.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_1/training_8.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_1/training_9.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_1/training_10.csv"
]

dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# Select only the columns needed for the target schema
cols_needed = ['company_permalink', 'funded_year', 'raised_amount_usd']
dfs_selected = [df[cols_needed] for df in dfs]

# Concatenate all source tables (UNION)
union_df = pd.concat(dfs_selected, ignore_index=True)

# Convert funded_year to integer (some sources have float)
union_df['funded_year'] = union_df['funded_year'].fillna(0).astype(int)

# Convert raised_amount_usd to numeric, fill NaN with 0, then convert to int
union_df['raised_amount_usd'] = pd.to_numeric(union_df['raised_amount_usd'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# Group by company_permalink and funded_year, sum raised_amount_usd
result = union_df.groupby(['company_permalink', 'funded_year'], as_index=False).agg({'raised_amount_usd': 'sum'})

# Write the final output with exact target schema column names
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_1/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
